questions.question: The average of the squares of four consecutive odd natural numbers is 201. The average of 7 times of the largest number and 3 times of the smallest number is:
questions.solution:
**Given**

Average of the squares of four consecutive odd natural numbers = 201

**concept**

Average = Sum of all observation/Number of observation

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

**Explanation**

Let the four odd consecutive natural numbers are x, (x + 2), (x + 4) and (x + 6)

[(x)² + (x + 2)² + (x + 4)² + (x + 6)²]/4 = 201

⇒ [x² + x² + 4 + 4x + x² + 16 + 8x + x² + 36 + 12x]/4 = 201

⇒ [4x² + 24x + 56]/4 = 201

⇒ x² + 6x + 14 = 201

⇒ x² + 6x - 187 = 0

⇒ x² + 17x - 11x - 187 = 0

⇒ x(x + 17) - 11(x + 17) = 0

⇒ (x - 11) (x + 17) = 0

⇒ x = 11 and x = - 17

Largest number is 17 i.e.(11 + 6)

7 times of largest number = 17 × 7

⇒ 119

Smallest number = 11

Three times of smallest number = 33

Required average = (119 + 33)/2

⇒ 152/2

⇒ 76

**∴ The average of 7 times of the largest number and 3 times of the smallest number is 76.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

Average lies between smallest and largest data .

we consider 4 four consecutive odd natural numbers like as 5,7 ,9,11 so 11² = 121 4 four consecutive odd natural numbers = 11² + 13² + 15² + 17²= 804 (average =201)

As per the question, average = ( 7 × 17 + 3 × 11)/2 = 76

n is divided by 12, the remainder is 5

 There remainder will be 3.

questions.question: If the simple interest on a certain sum of money borrowed for 4 years at 9.5% per annum exceeds the simple interest on the same sum for 3 years at 12.5% per annum by Rs. 225, then the sum borrowed is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net percentage interest for 4 years at 9.5% = 9.5% × 4 = 38%

Net percentage interest for 3 years at 12.5% = 12.5% × 3 = 37.5%

Difference in interest percentage = 38% − 37.5% = 0.5%

According to the question, 0.5% of **Sum** = Rs. 225

Total **Sum** (100%) = (225 ÷ 0.5) × 100 = 45,000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 45,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Rate 1** (R₁) = 9.5%, **Time 1** (T₁) = 4 years

**Rate 2** (R₂) = 12.5%, **Time 2** (T₂) = 3 years

Difference in **Simple Interest** = Rs. 225

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e12cea46e59cbb4bcfc1d6ac3220297a6489a007626a351c48bdd57a3af47516.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the borrowed **Sum** be P.

⇒ SI₁ = (P × 9.5 × 4) ÷ 100 = 38P ÷ 100

⇒ SI₂ = (P × 12.5 × 3) ÷ 100 = 37.5P ÷ 100

⇒ SI₁ − SI₂ = 225

⇒ (38P − 37.5P) ÷ 100 = 225

⇒ 0.5P ÷ 100 = 225

⇒ 0.5P = 22500

⇒ P = 22500 ÷ 0.5 = 45,000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 45,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest vs Compound Interest

While **Simple Interest** is calculated only on the principal, **Compound Interest** is calculated on the principal plus any accumulated interest from previous periods.

Effective Rate of Interest

For **Simple Interest**, the effective rate for a period is simply the product of the **Rate** and **Time** (R × T).

Sum Calculation from Difference

If the difference between interests is D, the **Principal** P = (D × 100) ÷ (R₁T₁ − R₂T₂).</p

questions.question: If x-(1)/(x)=2sqrt2, then what will be the value of x³-(1)/(x³)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If x − 1/x = k, then x³ − 1/x³ = k³ + 3k

Here, k = 2√2

Required value = (2√2)³ + 3 × (2√2)

⇒ 16√2 + 6√2 = 22√2

**∴ The correct answer is 22√2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x − 1/x = 2√2

**Formula Used:**

(a − b)³ = a³ − b³ − 3ab(a − b)

**Calculations:**

⇒ a³ − b³ = (a − b)³ + 3ab(a − b)

Substitute a = x and b = 1/x into the formula:

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = (x − 1/x)³ + 3 × x × (1/x) × (x − 1/x)

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = (x − 1/x)³ + 3(x − 1/x)

Put the given value of (x − 1/x) = 2√2:

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = (2√2)³ + 3 × 2√2

⇒ (2√2)³ = 2³ × (√2)³ = 8 × 2√2 = 16√2

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 16√2 + 6√2

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 22√2

**∴ The correct answer is 22√2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Cubes Identity

If x + 1/x = k, then x³ + 1/x³ = k³ − 3k.

Sum of Squares Identities

If x + 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² − 2. Conversely, if x − 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² + 2.

Sign Conversion Rules

If x + 1/x = k, then x − 1/x = √(k² − 4). Similarly, if x − 1/x = k, then x + 1/x = √(k² + 4).
</p

questions.question: If 3 cot A = 4 tan A and A is an acute angle, then what will be the value of sec A ?
questions.solution:

3 cot A = 4 tan A

cot A = 1 over tan A

Sec² A - tan² A = 1

**Calculation**

⇒ **3 cot A = 4 tan A**

⇒ 3 × 1 over tanA = 4 tan A

⇒ tan2 A= 3 over 4 

⇒ sec2A - 1= 3 over 4 

⇒ sec2A = 3 over 4 + 1 

⇒ sec2A = 7 over 4 

⇒ sec A = (sqrt7)/(2)

**∴ The value of secA is (sqrt7)/(2)**

questions.question: The circumference of a circle is 'aπ' units and the area of the circle is 'bπ' square units. If a ∶ b is equal to 4 ∶ 5, then the radius of the circle is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the radius of the circle be r.

Given Circumference = 2πr = aπ ⇒ a = 2r

Given Area = πr² = bπ ⇒ b = r²

Ratio a/b = 2r / r² = 2/r

Since a/b = 4/5 ⇒ 2/r = 4/5 ⇒ 4r = 10 ⇒ r = 2.5 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 2.5 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Circumference of the circle = aπ

Area of the circle = bπ

Ratio of a to b = a ÷ b = 4 ÷ 5

**Formula Used:**

Circumference of a circle = 2πr

Area of a circle = πr²

 
 
• 
 
 r = 2.5 cm
 Circumference = aπ
 Area = bπ
 a : b = 4 : 5

**Calculations:**

⇒ Circumference = 2πr = aπ

⇒ a = 2r

⇒ Area = πr² = bπ

⇒ b = r²

⇒ Given ratio a ÷ b = 4 ÷ 5

⇒ 2r ÷ r² = 4 ÷ 5

⇒ 2 ÷ r = 4 ÷ 5

⇒ 4r = 10

⇒ r = 10 ÷ 4 = 2.5 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 2.5 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of a Semi-Circle

The area of a semi-circle is exactly half of the area of a full circle: Area = 1/2 × πr².

Perimeter of a Semi-Circle

The perimeter includes the curved arc and the straight diameter: Perimeter = πr + 2r.

Area of a Sector

The area of a sector with a central angle θ in degrees is given by: Area = (θ ÷ 360) × πr².

Length of an Arc

The length of an arc subtending angle θ at the center is given by: Length = (θ ÷ 360) × 2πr.
</p

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90bf221478f92bdba2789d68c71fb51f93a3cb75a9a6631d02dbfaaef7ba8b40.png] 

**Given**

Perimeter of a rectangle = 60 cm

ratio of sides = 3 ∶ 2

**Formula used**

Area of rectangle = Length × Breadth

Perimeter of rectangle = 2(Length + Breadth)&l

questions.question: A customer availed a 10% discount on the purchase of a table and paid Rs. 4,950 for it. How much money would he have saved if he had bargained to get 12% discount?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Discount % = 10

Cost price = RS. 4950

**Formula used**

Cost Price = Market Price - Discount

**Calculation**

let the market price is Rs.x

so, 4950 = x - 10% of x

⇒ 4950 = 90x/100

⇒ x = (4950 × 100)/90

⇒ x = 5500

if discount rate is 12%

Then, cost price = 5500 - 12% of 5500

⇒ 5500 - 660

⇒ Rs. 4840

Money gained at 12% discount = RS.(4950 - 4840)

⇒ Rs. 110

**∴ Customer would save Rs. 110, if he had bargained to get 12% discount.**

questions.question: Amit purchased stationery marked for Rs. 8,000 at 12% discount and spent Rs. 160 on transportation. He sold the stationery at the marked price. Find his profit percentage.
questions.solution:
**Given**

Market price = Rs 8000

Discount = 12%

**Formula used**

Cost price = Market Price - Discount

Profit % = {profitover cost price} times 100

**Calculation**

Cost price = Market Price - Discount 

⇒ 8000 - 12% of 8000

questions.question: Suman and Lata working together can complete a task in 8 days. If Lata can complete the same task in 12 days, then how many days will Suman take to complete the same task?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Suman and Lata together complete a work in 8 days.

**Concept**

Firstly find the one day work done by each partner

**Explanation**

Let the Suman completes a work in x days.

So, work done by Suman in one day = 1/x

According to question

⇒ 1over x+ 1over 12 = 1over 8

⇒ 1over x = 1over 8 - 1over 12

⇒ 1over x= (3 - 2)over 24

⇒ 1over x = 1over 24

 ⇒ x = 24

**∴ Suman will take 24 days to complete a work. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** 

if C and D together do a work in X days, while C alone do work in X days, then D alone do a work in = XYover {Y - X }

⇒ (8 times 12) over (12 - 8) = 96over 4 = 24 days
